# Supertypes

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## basic

Basic cards are exempt from the four-copies deck construction limit.

Rules: CR 205.4c, CR 100.2a

```json
{
  "supertypes": [
    "basic"
  ]
}
```

## legendary

If a player controls two or more legendary permanents with the same name, they choose one and put the rest into their owners' graveyards (the legend rule).

Rules: CR 205.4d, CR 704.5j

```json
{
  "supertypes": [
    "legendary"
  ]
}
```
